title: Warm Slovakian Sugar Snap Peas Skillet
description: A savory and snappy Slovakian dish featuring sugar snap peas, perfect for a hangover cure, this recipe is also FODMAP friendly and includes a spherification process for added texture.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the diced bacon over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the cooked bacon from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sugar snap peas to the skillet and cook until they start to soften.
In a small bowl, mix the potato starch and chicken broth until smooth.
Add the starch mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the sauce has thickened.
In a separate bowl, mix the sodium alginate and water until dissolved.
Using a syringe or spoon, drop small amounts of the alginate mixture into the skillet and cook for a few seconds to spherify.
Season the skillet with salt and black pepper to taste.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
